name: @spsm/functions
description: Cloud Functions: Square checkout + webhook, prayer team notifications, claim management
//main: lib/index.js, not dist/. tsc emits dist/ with a live import of @spsm/shared; esbuild then bundles that into lib/. Only lib/ is deployable — see the build script.

scripts.//build: Two stages on purpose. tsc typechecks and emits; esbuild inlines @spsm/shared so the uploaded functions/ folder has no dependency on a sibling workspace. Cloud Build only ever receives this directory, so an unbundled @spsm/shared is looked up on the public npm registry and fails with a 404.
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions

//@spsm/shared: Deliberately absent from BOTH dependency lists, which looks like a mistake and is not. Cloud Build receives only this directory and runs a plain `npm install` — devDependencies included — so any mention of @spsm/shared sends it to the public registry, where it 404s. It does not need to be installed there: the esbuild step above inlines it, so the deployed bundle has no reference to it at runtime. Locally it resolves through the symlink npm workspaces puts in the repo-root node_modules for every workspace package, whether or not anything declares it. If a future tool insists on a declared dependency, the fix is a tsconfig path mapping plus an esbuild --alias, not a dependency entry.
//sharp: Native, and therefore --external in the esbuild step below: bundling a prebuilt .node binary is not something esbuild can do, and Cloud Build installs it properly from this dependency list anyway. It is the only dependency here that exists for the galleries pipeline.
